notes: Form N-14 8C (registration statement and joint proxy statement/prospectus, draft dated January 21, 2022, doc seq=1) for the reorganization of Nuveen Enhanced Municipal Value Fund (NEV, Target, common shares) into Nuveen Municipal Credit Income Fund (NZF, Acquiring, which also has preferred shares that remain outstanding). Filer is the acquiring closed-end fund; fund_type set to closed_end_fund. exchange_basis is nav_for_nav because the filing says aggregate NAV received equals aggregate NAV of Target shares; no fixed exchange ratio is stated, so exchange_ratio is null. Cash is only for fractional shares, so cash_per_share is null. Meeting, record and closing dates are blanks ([●], 2022) in this draft, so those fields are null and expected_close is uncertain. Closing-condition categories are taken from the Q&A and proxy text; the third-party consent (VRDP liquidity provider) is coded other. Estimated costs and fee figures are in the excerpt but are not event terms and are not recorded.
